playbookOutputs: Management accounts pack for the reporting period: profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow, budget vs actuals and KPI commentary, signed by Kevin Freese, CBA(SA) #3561
Trial balance and general ledger for the period from the AI Accountant module
playbookCommonFailures: Reporting period not agreed up front (monthly vs quarterly, which months), so the wrong period is compiled
Bank statements missing months or supplied as scans/photos that cannot be imported
No budget supplied, so budget vs actuals cannot be reported and the client is disappointed
Payroll summaries and EMP201s missing, so salary costs and PAYE liabilities are unsupported
Prior period figures unavailable, leaving no comparatives for trend or KPI analysis

informationToProvide.label: Company Name, Reporting Period (Start Month to End Month) & Purpose of Management Accounts
informationToProvide.helpText: Specify the company name, exact reporting period (e.g., 1 March 2026 to 31 August 2026), and purpose (e.g., Bank/Asset Finance, Tender, Provisional Tax, Board Review).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Company name, exact reporting period start/end dates, and purpose of the Management Accounts.

informationToProvide.label: Company Registration Certificate (CIPC CoR 14.3)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the CIPC CoR 14.3 registration certificate.
informationToProvide.aiHint: CIPC CoR 14.3 registration certificate confirming company details and directors.

informationToProvide.label: All Bank Statements for the Reporting Period (PDF / CSV)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload complete bank statements for all business accounts covering every month of the reporting period.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Complete business bank statements covering the management accounts reporting period.

informationToProvide.label: Sales Invoices, Supplier Invoices, Debtors/Creditors Lists & Asset Schedule
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload sales/purchase schedules, closing debtors & creditors lists, and any new asset/loan details for the period.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Sales and purchase records, closing debtors/creditors lists, and asset/loan schedules for the period.

informationToProvide.label: Payroll Summaries & EMP201 Returns for the Period (if applicable)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload payroll summaries if the company employs staff.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Payroll summaries and EMP201 declarations for the reporting period.

informationToProvide.label: Previous Year's Annual Financial Statements or Prior Management Accounts
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the latest signed AFS or prior Management Accounts for opening balances and comparatives.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Prior year Annual Financial Statements or prior Management Accounts for opening balances.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Agree the reporting period and collect source records
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Reporting period (months covered, monthly or quarterly) confirmed; bank statements, invoices, payroll and prior period/budget uploaded or confirmed not applicable
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: First confirm exactly which months the pack covers and whether the client wants monthly or quarterly reporting — this order covers one reporting period. Ask whether a budget exists and which KPIs matter to the owner (gross margin, debtor days, cash runway are the defaults). Chase only what is missing and explain why each item is needed. Do not promise faster than 3–5 working days from receipt of everything.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify records cover the period and belong to the entity
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Bank statements are original PDFs in the company's name with no gaps in the period; invoices and payroll fall within the period; opening balances agree to the prior period
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: The entity is the company on the CoR14.3, never the ordering contact. Reject scans and photos. Check statement balances chain month to month and list gaps. Confirm opening balances agree to the prior period's management accounts or AFS; if none, note that the balance sheet will be built from the bank and known balances only. Flag invoices dated outside the period.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Import bank statements and allocate transactions in AI Accountant
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Statements imported, every transaction allocated, invoices and payroll captured, bank reconciles to nil, period-end debtors and creditors listed
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: In the AI Accountant module: select the entity and the reporting period, import each PDF statement and allocate every line to the chart of accounts (set VAT treatment if the entity is VAT registered). Capture unpaid sales invoices as debtors and unpaid supplier invoices as creditors at period end; capture payroll costs and the PAYE/UIF/SDL liability from the EMP201s. Load the budget if supplied. Unidentified transactions go on a query list with date, amount and bank description — never dumped to sundry or the director's loan without a query.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Send allocation queries to the client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Client has answered every query or confirmed a default treatment
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Plain South African English. One consolidated list of unidentified transactions (date, amount, bank reference) with a question per item, plus confirmation of any period-end amounts owed to or by the business that are not visible in the bank. Keep it short — management accounts turn around quickly, so ask only what changes the numbers. No deadline threats.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Review trial balance, KPIs and approve adjustments
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin has reviewed the period TB, approved adjustments (accruals, prepayments, depreciation, payroll liabilities) and the KPI set, and locked the TB
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Prepare a proposal for Kevin: period TB, bank reconciliation, proposed adjustments (monthly depreciation, accruals and prepayments, payroll liabilities, VAT control if applicable), the budget vs actuals or period-on-period variance table with the largest variances highlighted, and a first draft of the KPI commentary. Kevin decides every adjustment and edits the commentary; the agent never posts a journal without approval.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft the management accounts pack
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Management accounts pack generated from the locked TB and posted for Kevin's review
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Generate the management_accounts_pack: cover with entity name, registration number and reporting period; profit and loss for the period with comparative (prior period and/or budget) and variance columns; balance sheet at period end; cash flow summary and a short cash flow forecast for the next period based on known commitments; budget vs actuals table where a budget exists; KPI page (gross margin %, net margin %, debtor days, creditor days, cash on hand vs monthly costs) with Kevin's commentary. State plainly that the accounts are unaudited management accounts prepared from records supplied by management. Signature block for Kevin Freese CBA(SA) #3561 — applied only at approval.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Send the pack to the client for review
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Client has confirmed the pack or raised queries that Kevin has resolved
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Plain South African English. Summarise the headline result and the two or three points from the commentary the owner should act on, and ask the client to confirm the pack is complete for the period. Requested changes to figures go to Kevin as a proposal — never change numbers to please the client.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver signed management accounts
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Signed management accounts pack, TB and general ledger posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Post the signed pack, the period trial balance and the general ledger export. Offer to set up the next period's management accounts and, if the financial year has ended, the annual financial statements service.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the pack is signed and the order can be completed
